About Us

Reliable, compassionate transportation — that's the whole job.

Caring Hands Transport, LLC provides exceptional transportation services to all its clients, and continues to strive for excellence by providing reliable and compassionate transportation across the Denver Metro Area.

Our Mission

Committed to serving the community.

Caring Hands Transport is committed to servicing the community by providing professional transportation. We offer specialized transportation services to seniors, clients using wheelchairs, and parents and children with special needs. We assist clients from the time of pick-up until their arrival at their destination, to ensure they arrive safely and on time — every time.

NMT & NEMT Transportation

Non-Medical and Non-Emergent Medical Transportation serves the needs of thousands by providing short- and long-distance transportation for seniors and people with disabilities.
